_comment: Shape of a client record. Real ones are gitignored. You should not need to write these by hand — `npm run add-client <url>` produces them from a URL. This exists so the format is documented, and so the backfill script has something to validate against.
name: Example Repairs
_businessType: local_service | ecommerce — decides which questions get asked, which findings apply, and what the report says
_platform: wordpress | shopify | webflow | squarespace | wix | custom — decides which ingest adapter reads the site
_aliases: Name variants for matching mentions inside AI answers. Generated automatically; businesses spell their own name inconsistently far more often than you would expect.
_phones: Every number found on the site. More than one is itself a finding.
_gbp: Google Business Profile. All null for a business without one, such as an online store.
_offerings: Services for a local business, product categories for a store. Drives question generation and the new pages.
_wrongGeoTerms: Places the site mentions that it does NOT serve. Derived per client during onboarding, never hardcoded — this is what catches a site built for the wrong area.
_locations: Towns a local business covers. An online store has none.
